data.body: **[P1] Finalize close-time scope fatals as `RETRYING`.** After the bounded handoff, invocation-end hooks may already have emitted the original `PENDING`/`RETRYING` outcome. If scope cleanup reports a fatal while `ExecutionManager.close()` subsequently waits, this check throws only after plugins have been released, so the backend retries while OTel/Insight never observe the fatal outcome. Observe the fatal before invocation-end dispatch and plugin release, and make the shutdown-window test assert one `RETRYING` end hook carrying the fatal.
